## Scorecard

10-aircraft MXP trombone, the fixed 100-seed pool, deterministic. **Success** = tier 5: every aircraft landed within ±60 s of its AMAN target, no loss of separation. Clean-subset success = success among episodes without a loss of separation.

A separate per-seed scoring of the same checkpoint (`analysis/2026-08-17_1_27_at10M_perseed.csv`) gives success 0.60, separation 0.07, worst-aircraft deviation 92.3 s: the 10-aircraft scorer does not pin the observation frame, so repeat scorings move by a few seeds.

Paired against `1_26` on success, per seed: 11 gained, 20 lost (not significant, McNemar).

**Attempts to solve** (stochastic retries until solved, cap 20): deterministic 0.62, pass@1 0.58, pass@5 0.71, pass@10 0.73, pass@20 0.74; never solved 26. Source: `analysis/2026-08-17_1_27_attempts_100seeds/attempts_per_seed.csv`.
